registration_echo.source: docs/efv-2026-07-23/GATES.md :: 'S-XLINE-4 gate registration - 2026-07-23 (pre-registered; incremental arms on the AUX winners)'

clauses.baseline: per arm: cross-fitted ridge (5-fold, by player) on the CURRENT-season stat-line inputs eFV consumes (hitters: wOBA-proxy z, K%, BB%, ISO z, age-for-level; pitchers: K%a, BB%a, ERA z, age-for-level), predicting the arm's outcome (hitters: next-season wOBA z; pitchers: next-season K%a z)
clauses.INC-1: AUX-1 p90 EV z vs the hitter baseline residual; lo95 > 0 proceeds
clauses.INC-2: AUX-2 whiff share vs the hitter baseline residual (sign: negative helps wOBA; and separately vs the next-K% residual, sign positive)
clauses.INC-3: AUX-3 FB velo vs the pitcher baseline residual; lo95 > 0 proceeds
clauses.age_interaction: descriptive, not verdict-bearing: incremental rho by age-for-level half (younger vs older), each arm
clauses.ship_rule: an INC pass makes the signal ELIGIBLE for a bounded live overlay on A/CPX prospects (magnitude bounded so no served grade moves more than 2 FV, default-OFF flag, post-flip check vs a fresh baseline snapshot with the 2-FV ceiling, registry row provisional, chip copy in the eFV explainer); INC fail = recorded NULL, signal stays display-only

upstream.selection_bias_carryover: the S-XLINE-3 selection-bias falsifications on these exact covered pools were clean (no confounded flags); INC re-uses those pools

datasets.note: A-ball 2023-2025 -> Y+1, >= 150 PA / >= 150 BF both legs, outcome z within the destination (max-exposure level, season) pool; 2025->2026 outcome leg is 2026 season-to-date

hit_next_woba_z.training_universe: FULL stat-line-eligible A-ball pair universe (covered and uncovered), the strongest stat-line baseline

hit_next_k_z.training_universe: FULL stat-line-eligible A-ball pair universe (covered and uncovered), the strongest stat-line baseline

pit_next_k_z.training_universe: FULL stat-line-eligible A-ball pair universe (covered and uncovered), the strongest stat-line baseline

INC_2_whiff.verdict_rule: the registration lists two directional channels (negative vs the wOBA residual; positive vs the next-K% residual); the arm PASSES if a channel clears its bar, and overlay eligibility extends only to the channel(s) that cleared

INC_1_p90ev.note: descriptive, not verdict-bearing (registered); rho = Spearman(signal z, baseline residual) within the half

INC_2_whiff_vs_woba_residual.note: descriptive, not verdict-bearing (registered); rho = Spearman(signal z, baseline residual) within the half

INC_2_whiff_vs_k_residual.note: descriptive, not verdict-bearing (registered); rho = Spearman(signal z, baseline residual) within the half

INC_3_fb_velo.note: descriptive, not verdict-bearing (registered); rho = Spearman(signal z, baseline residual) within the half

conventions.signals: identical per-season z construction to the S-XLINE-3 AUX arms (p90 EV: >= 25 BBE covered pool; whiff share: >= 100 pitches seen; FB velo: >= 50 tracked FB)
conventions.incremental_statistic: Spearman(signal z, out-of-fold baseline residual) on the signal-covered rows
conventions.bootstrap: percentile, 2000 reps, seed 20260723, resampling rows with residuals held fixed from the single cross-fit (the player-fold cross-fit is the leakage guard)
conventions.age_for_level: StatsAPI seasonal age on the A-ball row; every row in a pool is at the same level, so age IS age-for-level within the pool

caveats: the baseline trains on the FULL stat-line-eligible universe, not just covered rows - the strongest stat-line baseline, biasing against a false INC pass
A-level batted-ball/pitch tracking is park-dependent for INC-1/INC-3 (S-XLINE-3 selection-bias reads were clean on these pools)
ridge lambda 1.0 is an a-priori default on standardized features, not tuned against any arm result
next_step_if_pass: bounded live overlay on A/CPX prospects per the registered ship rule (2-FV ceiling, default-OFF flag, post-flip check, registry row provisional, chip copy); an in-matrix feature ship stays impossible until A-ball-covered cohorts resolve

frozen_coefficients.fit: OLS signal_z ~ current-K z on the exact INC pair populations (A-ball 2023-2025, lab accumulators); frozen 2026-07-23, serve time never refits

overlay.mechanism: delta_fv = clamp(0.6 * direction * residual_z, +-2.0) on the run_live MODEL leg (priced through the blend's consensus-OLS FV->WAR slope); hitters direction -1 (whiff residual = unpaid K risk), pitchers +1 (velo residual = unpaid K upside); chip 'A-ball Statcast lean'

off_invariance.detail: flags OFF regen_all with the hook live: data/xfv.json byte-identical, sha256 ef04e91a before/after

battery.structural_reading: the served headline is a rank-preserving quantile map onto the live consensus-FV distribution; in the fringe region the step between adjacent display values is 2.7 FV (35.0 <-> 37.7), so ANY rank-moving overlay breaches the registered 2.0 ceiling - a display-layer structural blocker, not a magnitude to tune

overlay.verdict: post-flip FAIL per the registered clause -> flip REVERTED (data/xfv.json byte-identical to baseline, verified), defaults stay OFF; implementation retained as a dead-by-default dial with OFF=identity pinned by test_statcast_overlay.py
overlay.keep_alive: revival requires a NEW registration with a ceiling defined on a surface the mechanism can bound (display-space clamp vs a no-overlay shadow ranking, or a rank-displacement bound), registered BEFORE any re-run
